summary: Full frontend regression run for the two new features: 'Top Rated by Labs' section on Home and the 'Write Your Review' post-purchase flow. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passed. No console errors, no page errors, and no regressions detected across Home / PDP / Checkout / Stacks / Guide, on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844).

issues: The large ghost 'LIFESCIENCES' text in the hero wraps to two lines ('LIFESCIEN' / 'CES') on narrow viewports — cosmetic only, does not block anything.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 136-line file but each line is extremely long (many components on one line). Consider splitting into per-component modules for maintainability — /components/TopRated.jsx, /components/WriteReview.jsx, /components/ProductReviews.jsx, /pages/Checkout.jsx etc. Not a functional issue, but future edits will be error-prone.

ratingFor / reviewCountFor are pure deterministic helpers — good. They are declared AFTER TopRatedSection uses them; JS function hoisting saves it, but relying on hoisting in tightly packed one-liners is fragile.

Checkout.placeOrder uses setTimeout(1800) to navigate to /account after order — during those 1.8s the order-placed panel is shown but the ORDER SUMMARY on the right still lists cart items (cart is already cleared in state on next render — verified cart-count=0). Cosmetic, not a bug.
biotech-my-reviews is stored per-slug with an array — no cap on entries; a user can flood the review grid with N 'yours' cards. Consider limiting to 1 review per product per user (or overwrite).
WriteReview form: title field is optional but the 'Your review' card falls back to 'Verified purchase' — good. name is required client-side but there is no length/format validation.
No sanitisation of review-text before rendering — currently rendered inside {r.text} which React escapes, so XSS-safe. Good.

productExtra entry for 'bac-water' has empty goals array — TopRated ranking includes it if its rating ties; currently it did not surface in top-4 in this run, but with only reviewCount as tiebreak it could appear. Not incorrect, just noting.
seed_data_creation: During testing, localStorage was seeded with biotech-age=yes, and biotech-purchased/biotech-my-reviews were populated by exercising the real checkout + review flow (not manually injected).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified acceptance criteria (evidence captured in run output):
- top-rated-section renders between goals-section and Handpicked section (goalIdx=2, topIdx=3).
- 4 rank-badge cards render (#1 Klow80 5.0/109, #2 BPC-157+TB-500 5.0/79, #3 AOD-9604 5.0/44, #4 NAD+ 5.0/44).
- top-rated-0 links to /products/klow80. Klow80's PDP reviews-summary shows '5.0 / 5 · 109 VERIFIED RESEARCHER REVIEWS' — matches Home.
- review-locked visible on retatrutide before purchase; write-review-form not present.
- Checkout flow (name/email/address/city/postcode/research-use checkbox + place-demo-order) shows order-placed panel and cart-count returns to 0. localStorage.biotech-purchased = ["retatrutide"].
- After returning to /products/retatrutide review-locked disappears, write-review-form appears with rate-star-1..5, review-name, review-title, review-text, review-submit.
- Submitting shows review-thanks and after reload my-review-0 appears with 'YOUR REVIEW' badge; localStorage.biotech-my-reviews correctly stores the submission.
- All 3 nav CTAs, 9 goals-strip links, /stacks (stack-builder), /guide (peptide-guide) render.
- Mobile 390x844: topratedgrid computes to '188px 188px' (2 cols) and nav-cta-shop is offscreen/hidden as expected.
- 0 console errors, 0 page errors across the full flow.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration; nothing to RCA.
